name: – Christophe Grudler – Draft Council decision
title: RECOMMENDATION on the draft Council decision on the conclusion of a broad package of agreements between the European Union, of the one part, and the Swiss Confederation, of the other part, to consolidate, deepen and expand the bilateral relations, and amending Decisions 2011/51/EU and 2011/738/EU
part_text:
The European Parliament approves a large package of agreements between the European Union and Switzerland. The package updates and expands the existing bilateral relationship. It covers free movement of people, air and land transport, mutual recognition of product checks, farm trade, electricity, health, Swiss payments to reduce economic gaps in the EU, Swiss participation in EU programmes and space work, and cooperation between parliaments. Parliament gives its consent, so the agreements can be concluded. The report itself is a recommendation to approve, not a change to the content.

- The EU and Switzerland update their existing agreements and add new ones on electricity, health and Swiss payments.
- People who live, work, study or travel across the EU-Swiss border, plus businesses trading in goods and services.
- Parliament has approved; the Council can now conclude the agreements, which then enter into force.
